**BUILD SUCCEEDED**. Phase 1 (App shell) is implemented and verified:

- `App.tsx` — sets up a React Navigation native-stack with Home (headerless), Health, and Transcribe screens
- `screens/HomeScreen.tsx` — title `Native Bench`, subtitle `Token economics benchmark`, `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons
- `screens/HealthScreen.tsx` — placeholder with all §3.2 labels, `Log 500 Steps` disabled, back nav via stack header
- `screens/TranscribeScreen.tsx` — placeholder with all §3.3 labels, `Transcribe Sample` disabled, back nav via stack header
- `components/Button.tsx` — shared styled button with disabled state
- Added `@react-navigation/native`, `@react-navigation/native-stack`, `react-native-screens`, `react-native-safe-area-context` via `expo install` (properly pinned in `package.json`/`package-lock.json` — they were previously stray, untracked `node_modules` leftovers)

No native platform calls were added, per phase-1 scope; the build command in CLAUDE.md passed end-to-end.
